question: Which hotel are available within 70 kilometers along the route from American Folk Art Museum, New York, NY to CUNY School of Professional Studies, New York, NY?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.981596 40.77323)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.990094 40.748387)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'hotel'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.981596 40.77323)',4326)::geography, 70000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.981596 40.77323)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
